title: When temporal pooling changes predictive risk: observation boundaries and how rankings depend on the loss - research code and evidence

creators.name: Zhang, Junjie
creators.affiliation: Shanghai Academy of Global Governance & Area Studies; School of Economics and Finance; Shanghai International Studies University, Shanghai 201620, China

description: Research code, frozen protocols and numerical evidence for a study of temporal pooling observation boundaries and loss dependent risk rankings. Includes the exact finite-state risk algebra with its complete reversal region, uniform margins, target-noise bound and support-perturbation counterexample; the frozen 325-fit neural protocol with per-seed scores, condition summaries, paired contrasts, frozen draws and fitted checkpoints; and the executed verification records. The manuscript, supplementary document, cover letter and AI-use statement are not part of this archive, and provider electricity files are not redistributed. The real-data study evaluated in the paper remains in version 1.0.0 of the same archive (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23100654). MIT applies to author-created software; author-generated synthetic data, result tables and figures are CC BY 4.0.
